verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms a first-party n8n API exists (a docs page titled 'n8n API'), and an official CLI is documented as an extra programmatic surface. Nothing describes what the API covers or shows that it matches the UI, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at the tried paths on the docs domain, so coverage cannot be checked. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of workflows, credentials, executions and admin; evidence of UI-to-API parity; a published OpenAPI spec; independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.
